title: See Financial Data OFF: the WO Fees & Discounts card is hidden entirely
preconds:
1. The FeesAndDiscounts feature flag is ON for the organization.
  2. A work order with a whole-WO flat fee exists in the admin's default workplace.
  3. A user is assigned a custom role that has See Financial Data OFF, View mode set to Full View, and Work orders View.
steps:
1. As an admin (See Financial Data ON), confirm the work order carries the fee — the Fees & Discounts card would render for a permitted user.
  2. Log in as the restricted user and open that work order's Lines tab directly.
  3. Wait for the work order lines table to render.
  4. Look for the Fees & Discounts card in the sidebar.
expected: The Fees & Discounts card is not rendered at all — no card title, no adjustment names, no rate badges, no amounts. The whole card is gated on See Financial Data (SV-8430), not just its money figures.
